title.en: Why did engagement fall at minute 40?

problem.en: Meera, this is your launch-week Day 2 stream: 3 hours, peak 682 CCV. At 38:00 you had 556 viewers; by 59:00, 348 were left. That's a 37% drop. Let's work out why, from your own graph.
problem.hi-Latn: Meera, yeh tumhara launch week Day 2 ka stream hai: 3 ghante, peak 682 CCV. 38:00 pe 556 viewers the, 59:00 tak sirf 348 bache. Yaani 37% drop. Chalo, tumhare apne graph se samajhte hain kyun.

caseData.stream: Launch week Day 2 · GTA 6 (named only) · 3 h · start 20:00 IST

n1-what-changed.goal: Get Meera to connect the drop to what changed on her stream at 38:00.

say.en: Look at your graph: CCV starts falling right after 40:00. What was happening on stream just then?
say.hi-Latn: Apna graph dekho: 40:00 ke just baad CCV girna shuru hota hai. Us waqt stream pe kya chal raha tha?

expect.desc: Links the drop to the segment change at 38:00: the mission ended and the silent grind started.

misconceptions.desc: Blames something outside the stream (a bigger streamer went live, the algorithm, the platform) without checking her own segments.

say.en: What did you switch to on stream at 38:00?
say.hi-Latn: 38:00 pe tumne stream pe kya switch kiya tha?

say.en: Check your run-of-show: 12 to 38 was the mission. Then?
say.hi-Latn: Apna run-of-show dekho: 12 se 38 mission tha. Uske baad?

say.en: At 38:00 the mission ended and the cash grind started. The drop comes two minutes later.
say.hi-Latn: 38:00 pe mission khatam hua aur cash grind shuru hua. Drop do minute baad aata hai.

say.en: The drop lines up with your segment change: from the mission to a silent grind.
say.hi-Latn: Drop tumhare segment change ke saath line up karta hai: mission se silent grind.

chips.text: 38 pe mission khatam karke cash grind shuru kiya tha.
Bhai us time koi bada streamer live aaya tha, sab wahan chale gaye.
Pata nahi yaar, achanak gir gaya.

s1-bands.goal: Show that the drop and the recovery both line up with her own segment changes, which an outside cause would not explain.

say.en: Here are your segments on the same graph. The drop starts two minutes after the grind began, and CCV climbs back as soon as the next segment starts at 60:00. An outside cause wouldn't line up that neatly.
say.hi-Latn: Same graph pe apne segments dekho. Drop grind shuru hone ke 2 minute baad start hota hai, aur 60:00 pe naya segment aate hi CCV wapas chadhta hai. Bahar ki koi wajah itni exact line up nahi hoti.

n2-chat-first.goal: Get Meera to read chat as the early warning: it fell before CCV.

say.en: Now add your chat line. Which fell first: chat or CCV?
say.hi-Latn: Ab chat wali line bhi dekho. Pehle kya gira: chat ya CCV?

expect.desc: Notices chat fell first (87 to 15 messages a minute between 37:00 and 41:00) while CCV only started falling after 40:00; chat is the early warning.
Says both fell together, missing that chat led.

say.en: At 39:00, where was chat, and where was CCV?
say.hi-Latn: 39:00 pe chat kitna tha, aur CCV kitna?

say.en: Chat had halved by 39:00; CCV hadn't fallen even 10% until 43:00.
say.hi-Latn: Chat 39:00 tak aadha ho chuka tha; CCV 43:00 tak 10% bhi nahi gira tha.

say.en: Chat fell four minutes earlier. That was the warning.
say.hi-Latn: Chat 4 minute pehle gira. Wahi warning thi.

say.en: Chat rate falls before CCV: when chat goes quiet, viewers start leaving a few minutes later.
say.hi-Latn: Chat rate CCV se pehle girta hai: jab chat shaant hota hai, viewers kuch minute mein nikalne lagte hain.

chips.text: Arre, chat toh 38 se hi dead ho gaya tha. CCV baad mein gira.
Dono ek saath hi gire na?

n3-what-missing.goal: Get Meera to name what the grind lacked compared with the mission: talk, a stated goal, a chat loop.

say.en: So chat went quiet first. What did the grind segment lack that the mission had?
say.hi-Latn: Matlab chat pehle shaant hua. Grind segment mein kya missing tha jo mission mein tha?

expect.desc: Names what was missing: commentary, a stated goal or stakes, and a chat loop (reading chat, a poll).

misconceptions.desc: Concludes that grinding itself is the problem ('never grind again'), not how the grind was run.

say.en: What were you doing during the mission that stopped in the grind?
say.hi-Latn: Mission ke time tum kya kya kar rahi thi jo grind mein band ho gaya?

say.en: Mic, goal, chat: what happened to all three?
say.hi-Latn: Mic, goal, chat: teeno ka kya hua?

say.en: In the grind your mic was mostly off, no goal was said and chat wasn't read.
say.hi-Latn: Grind mein mic mostly off tha, koi goal nahi bola, aur chat nahi padha.

say.en: The hook was gone: no talk, no goal, no chat loop.
say.hi-Latn: Hook gayab tha: na baat, na goal, na chat loop.

chips.text: Mic off tha, koi goal nahi bola, chat bhi nahi padha.
Grind content hi boring hai. Next time grind hi nahi karungi.

s2-compare.goal: Correct the overcorrection: the same kind of mission-free gameplay recovered when it was run with chat polls and talk.

say.en: Compare 38–60 with 60–92. Neither had a mission; both were just gameplay. In the second you ran two chat polls and talked through the plan, and CCV went from 351 to 477. Same game, different structure.
say.hi-Latn: 38–60 ko 60–92 se compare karo. Dono mein mission nahi tha, dono bas gameplay tha. Doosre mein tumne do chat polls chalaye aur plan bol-bol ke khela, aur CCV 351 se 477 pe pahuncha. Game same, structure alag.

n4-experiment.goal: Get Meera to design one testable change for the next stream, with a measure.

say.en: Grinds will happen in launch week. Pick one change for your next stream, and say how you'll know it worked.
say.hi-Latn: Launch week mein grind toh hoga hi. Next stream ke liye ek change socho, aur batao kaise pata chalega ki kaam kiya.

expect.desc: Proposes one specific change (for example grind at most 10 minutes, say the goal, a poll every 5 minutes) with a success measure (chat rate, CCV change in that segment).
Proposes a change without a measure, or several changes at once.

say.en: One change only. What will you change, and which number will you watch?
say.hi-Latn: Sirf ek change. Kya badlogi, aur kaunsa number dekhogi?

say.en: Playbook §5: grind at most 10 minutes, say the goal, run a chat mechanic.
say.hi-Latn: Playbook §5: grind max 10 minute, goal bolo, chat mechanic chalao.

say.en: For example: 'Grind 10 minutes, a poll every 5 minutes. Success: chat above 40 a minute, CCV drop under 10%.'
say.hi-Latn: Jaise: 'Grind 10 minute, har 5 minute poll. Success: chat 40/min se upar, CCV drop 10% se kam.'

say.en: One change, one measure, one stream. Then check the result in the next review.
say.hi-Latn: Ek change, ek measure, ek stream. Phir agle review mein result dekho.

chips.text: Grind max 10 min, pehle goal bolungi, har 5 min ek poll. Chat 40/min se upar rahe aur CCV 10% se kam gire toh kaam kiya.
Next time zyada energy ke saath khelungi.

n5-pitch.goal: Get Meera to pitch the diagnosis and the experiment to her agency manager in two lines (expression evidence).

say.en: Your agency manager has 30 seconds. Pitch the diagnosis and the experiment in two lines.
say.hi-Latn: Tumhare agency manager ke paas 30 second hain. Diagnosis aur experiment do line mein pitch karo.

expect.desc: Two clear lines: the cause (silent grind after the mission; chat fell first, CCV −37%) and the experiment with its measure.
Misses the cause or the measure, or runs long.

say.en: Line 1: what happened and why. Line 2: what you'll do next stream, and how you'll measure it.
say.hi-Latn: Line 1: kya hua aur kyun. Line 2: next stream mein kya karogi, aur kaise naapogi.

say.en: Start with the number: 'CCV fell 37% during…'
say.hi-Latn: Number se shuru karo: 'CCV 37% gira jab…'

say.en: '…a 22-minute silent grind after the mission; chat dropped first.' Then the change and the target.
say.hi-Latn: '…mission ke baad 22 minute ka silent grind tha; chat pehle gira.' Phir change aur target.

say.en: 'A 22-minute silent grind after the mission cost 37% of CCV; chat fell first. Next stream: grind 10 minutes with a goal and a poll every 5 minutes; target chat above 40 a minute and a CCV drop under 10%.'
say.hi-Latn: 'Mission ke baad 22 minute ke silent grind mein CCV 37% gira; chat pehle gira. Next stream: grind 10 minute, goal + har 5 minute poll; target chat 40/min se upar aur CCV drop 10% se kam.'

c1-conclusion.goal: Close with the conclusion Meera reached, in her language, and hand off to the scorecard.

say.en: Here's what you worked out.
say.hi-Latn: Tumne jo nikala, woh yeh hai.

summary.en: The drop wasn't the platform or tired viewers. At 38:00 the mission ended and a silent grind began: no goal, no talk, no chat loop. Chat fell first (87 to 15 a minute), then CCV (556 to 348, −37%). When you brought chat back at 60:00, CCV recovered to 477. Next stream: grind at most 10 minutes, say the goal, poll every 5 minutes. Success: chat above 40 a minute and a CCV drop under 10% in that segment.
summary.hi-Latn: Drop platform ya thake hue viewers ki wajah se nahi tha. 38:00 pe mission khatam hua aur silent grind shuru hua: na goal, na baat, na chat loop. Pehle chat gira (87 se 15 per minute), phir CCV (556 se 348, −37%). 60:00 pe chat ko wapas laayi toh CCV 477 tak recover hua. Next stream: grind max 10 minute, goal bolo, har 5 minute poll. Success: us segment mein chat 40/min se upar aur CCV drop 10% se kam.

meta.status: Draft for S5 review. Machine-drafted Hinglish; needs a native Hinglish reviewer and a practising streamer.
meta.languageCode: hi-Latn (BCP 47: Hindi in Latin script) for romanised Hinglish. Contract §0 lists ISO 639-1 codes only; the hub should confirm this code.
meta.extraFields: scriptedPath, scriptedScorecard, videoScorecard, sceneStates and meta are additive fields for the video and a replay. They are not part of kiki-tutor-graph/v0; a v0 loader can ignore them.
scoringRules: A metric's level is its latest evidence, except: a branch reached after a hint rung is capped at partial; after the answer rung it is not_yet.
A misconception corrected by a show node leaves that metric at most partial until later evidence.
Words evidence comes from expression.termsUsed; expression evidence from the articulation node and expression.clarity.

metricDefinitions.diagnosis: Finds the cause of the engagement change in her own stream data, not outside it.
metricDefinitions.audience: Reads what the audience did and when: chat as the early warning, CCV as the lagging measure.
metricDefinitions.structure: Names what a segment needs to hold viewers (talk, a goal or stakes, a chat loop) and doesn't overcorrect.
metricDefinitions.experiment: Designs one change for the next stream with a measure and a threshold.
metricDefinitions.articulation: Pitches the diagnosis and the experiment to her agency manager in two lines.
